title: Mickey no Tokyo Disneyland Daibouken - Pirates of the Caribbean (Cave)
description:
The background seen in the first level of Mickey no Tokyo Disneyland Daibouken, a Super Famicom game that was never officially localized.

Compared to the old version in the site, this one uses less tiles, while having more details (like the ship in the background).

The background is easy to adjust.

A good fit for pirate-themed levels, in general.
